source.method: Internet Archive captures of the sellers' price pages read in gpu_rental-2026-11-18.json, found with the CDX API (one capture per month at most, then the months around each change), fetched in id_ mode and read by hand; the cell is quoted. A record is a capture where a price was seen, not every capture: a price holds between two records of the same offer. Fields as in gpu_rental-2026-11-18.json plus captured (the capture date) and archive_url. EUR prices use the 2026-11-18 ECB rate. Not in the archive or not readable: Oracle's price API, Azure's price API, Vast.ai (live marketplace), OVHcloud's B300 (first listed after 2026-11-01).
